knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A cracked heater is taken out of service and isolated, and its repair or replacement is referred to a licensed person where the rules require it.
Wiring work is for a person authorised for it in the state. Completing this lesson does not give that authority, and a safety switch does not make the work allowed.
A sump with limited access and standing water can be a confined space. The correct response assesses it first and refuses entry without the procedure, a standby person and any permit.

practicalCriteria: Learner isolates and secures a training pump at the isolator, proves it off where the procedure requires, and records the isolation with time and name
Learner refuses to enter a training cabinet without a procedure and a standby person, and records the reason
Learner writes a referral for a cracked heater on a training set-up, after taking it out of service and labelling it
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark. With three questions, all three must be correct. Practical sign-off is assessed separately by observation and is not verified by this quiz.
evidenceRequired: Isolation record with time and person
Fault report and referral note for the heater
Assessor observation of isolation and the refusal to enter
stopWorkCriteria: Work on a heater or pump without isolation, securing and proof of the power off
Entry to a cabinet, sump or void without the procedure and a standby person
A request to tape up or keep running a damaged heater or lead
